page_note: Page is almost entirely Manichaean ecclesial institutional teaching: the three "matters" or works of the catechumens (almsgiving to Church, giving a son/relative to the Church, building a dwelling-place for the Elect), then a new chapter ("Concerning the begetting of a multitude of angels") opening with apostolic dialogue frame and continuing with ecclesial fasting practice (Lord's day, elect, catechumens). No cosmological substrate present. Editorial fatigue score is significant; the second half adds the apostolic dialogue frame on top of the ecclesial content.
